summary: Inspect retained upgrade archives and explicitly clean unreferenced old data
details: upgrade-status and preview-only upgrade-cleanup show retained dataset locations, allocated/logical sizes, private preservation estimates and known references. Existing r7 upgrade records are supported without repeating the upgrade.

Explicit cleanup requires stopped services and interactive confirmation. It checks standard account configurations, Docker mounts, registered/sibling/explicit legacy upgrade records, database locks and open processes, then hash-verifies private and unknown files before removing only the selected old archives.

Cleanup durably relinquishes rollback before deletion and can resume after partial removal. Recovery/configuration backups remain; current datasets, Bitcoin Core, balance-history, wallets and node identities are preserved. New upgrades register their recovery directory; unregistered legacy records and custom consumers require operator review.
operator_actions: To reclaim old upgrade data after acceptance, inspect upgrade-status --backup-dir PATH, review legacy/custom references, stop the node and explicitly run upgrade-cleanup --backup-dir PATH --execute. Keep the recovery directory and original release kits.
